items.title: WALLENSTAM: Events during the third quarter 2026
items.summary: WALLENSTAM: Events during the third quarter 2026 2026-10-01 08:00:00 During the quarter, 199 apartments in the Årstaberg project in Stockholm were completed and let, bringing the total number of apartments currently under construction to 1,078. Wallenstam has also completed the divestment of all its wind farms in accordance with the agreement with Locus Energy. In Årstaberg, Stockholm, 199 apartments have been completed and let in buildings 2 and 3. The remaining phases of the project comprise an additional 210 apartments that are under construction. items.title: Wallenstam continues to develop Polhemsplatsen - Happy Days to open new restaurant in summer 2027
items.summary: Wallenstam continues to develop Polhemsplatsen - Happy Days to open new restaurant in summer 2027 2026-09-08 08:05:00 Wallenstam has signed a lease for Happy Days' establishment at Polhemsplatsen 1. The restaurant will open in summer 2027 with an American street food concept and is thus establishing itself in one of the city's most prominent locations. The property, which has recently undergone an extensive reconstruction and extension, is located close to the Central Station, Ullevi and Gothenburg's major event district.
